Preserve fee rates, percentages, amounts, dates, subjects, formulas, accounts, share classes and every fee topic unless an obligation explicitly removes it. Do not introduce a number that is not in the source, the guide text or the verified facts. Return the complete replacement for the span, not a diff. List the source literals you preserved.
